proposals.content_angle: Built on the World Heritage Centre listing and Decision 47 COM 8B.22: a serial property of 12 components tied to Truc Lam Zen Buddhism, founded in the 13th century by King Tran Nhan Tong, spread over Quang Ninh, Bac Ninh and Hai Phong; notes that sources use provincial names from before and after the 2025 mergers (Bac Giang now Bac Ninh, Hai Duong now Hai Phong) and that some reports cite the 18 August 2025 domestic ceremony next to the 12 July 2025 inscription, and tells the Writer to verify opening hours and access rules and give no ticket prices.
